summary.description: One or two sentences: Codex's overall position in this round.

id.description: Stable identifier. Codex-raised points are C1, C2; Claude-raised points keep their L1, L2 ids. Never renumber.

reason.description: The full reasoning behind the statement or stance, not a summary.

evidence.description: file:line references or command/output excerpts supporting the point; empty only when none exist.

kind.description: fact = directly observed (file content, command output); inference = reasoned from observations.

stance.description: Position on a carried point: accept the other side's position, maintain your own, or revise to a wording both could accept. null on a new point.

revised_statement.description: The proposed wording when stance is revise; otherwise null.

user_call.description: true when the point is a preference or authority question for the user, not a matter of right or wrong.

user_call_reason.description: Why the point is the user's call when user_call is true; otherwise null.

new_blocking.description: true for a new point raised after round 1 that blocks the conclusion.

reopen.description: true when the point reopens a tentative agreement.

open_questions.description: Questions Codex could not resolve and that would change its position.
